variantInfo.name: Locust rider

Drops 2,000 coin piles and occasionally noted bass.

variantInfo.name: Scarab mage
notes: Magic attacker with an unusual 15-tick attack speed, making prayer flicking straightforward.

notes: Only 1 Slayer XP per kill; poisonous, 1-tick attack speed, only aggressive to the player that spawned them.

variantInfo.name: Small scarab

taskNotes: Scabarites require 85 combat and partial completion of Contact!; only Nieve assigns them (30-60, weight 4).
The Get scabaright on it unlock (50 points) extends assignments to 130-170.
Scabarites count as kalphites, so the keris and keris partisan special effects apply to them.
Locust riders and scarab mages in Sophanem Dungeon are the usual targets; scarab swarms give only 1 Slayer XP.
Small scarabs in the Uzer Mastaba (The Curse of Arrav, partial) are a low-level alternative with no drops.
Be mindful of the floor trap at the Sophanem Dungeon entrance and bring a lantern and tinderbox.
Guthan's equipment against locust riders with Protect from Missiles sustains long trips; a dwarf multicannon on the cavern level is fastest.
Giant Scarab in the Nightmare Zone also counts but is quest-boss content, not a slayer location.

slayerTargetId 247 is a SYNTHETIC placeholder (240 + WC index 7, team contract 2026-07-02, Frost-Dragons precedent); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value for Scabarites is not wiki-published, so varp-based detection falls back to the task-name path.
recommendedMethod: Kill locust riders and scarab mages on the Sophanem Dungeon cavern level, with a dwarf multicannon and Protect from Missiles for speed or Guthan's for sustain; a keris partisan exploits their kalphite classification.
